visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera is positioned inside a commercial airplane cabin, looking down the center aisle towards the front. Thick, white mist is seen pouring out of the overhead vents, swirling across the ceiling and partially obscuring the overhead bins. Seated passengers are visible from behind, many with their heads bowed or looking at their personal devices, appearing remarkably calm despite the hazy environment. Bold yellow text overlays are prominently displayed at the top and bottom of the frame, providing context. The lighting is composed of warm artificial cabin lights mixed with a slightly cooler glow from the mist-filled area. (2) The camera performs a slight zoom-in on the overhead panels where the mist is most concentrated. The white vapor drifts in soft, turbulent patterns, resembling smoke but lacking the chaotic movement of a fire. Close-up details of the seat numbers and the "fasten seatbelt" signs are partially hidden by the dense mist. No physical movements from the passengers are captured other than the slight tremor of a handheld camera. The background setting is a standard economy class layout with blue seat headrests and small screens integrated into the back of each seat. (3) The camera pans slightly to the right, showing more rows of the airplane cabin filled with the same white mist. The mist seems to settle in a layer just below the ceiling, creating a foggy atmosphere throughout the upper half of the plane. Passengers remain motionless in their seats, and no crew members are visible in this specific shot. The lighting remains stable and warm, reflecting off the plastic surfaces of the overhead bins. The yellow variety-show style text continues to appear at the bottom, explaining the phenomenon as the video reaches its conclusion.
